questions.q: Where are real SLA Definition records stored on the platform?
options: The `task_sla` table
The `contract_sla` table
The `incident` table directly
A hard-coded platform setting with no backing table
questions.explain: SLA Definitions are stored on `contract_sla` — the template record, not the running instance.

questions.q: What does the Applies To condition on an SLA Definition actually control?
options: How long the SLA's duration target is
Which records this SLA Definition attaches to in the first place
Who gets notified when the SLA breaches
Which report displays the SLA's results
questions.explain: Applies To is the condition builder, e.g. incident where Priority = 1, that decides which records qualify for this definition at all.

questions.q: Why can starting an SLA's timer on record creation produce a misleading resolution-time number?
options: It cannot — record creation is always the correct Start condition
It bakes in time the record spent queued before anyone began working it, counting that against the team
Record creation is not a valid condition for a Start condition builder
It only affects Priority 2 and lower incidents
questions.explain: A Start condition tied to creation includes queue time before work began, changing what the SLA actually measures versus starting on State = In Progress.

questions.q: What is created when a real record satisfies an SLA Definition's Applies To and Start conditions?
options: A new `contract_sla` record
A `task_sla` record — one running instance tracking that specific record
A new Incident record
Nothing is created until the SLA breaches
questions.explain: The SLA Definition is a template; a matching record generates its own `task_sla` instance tracking elapsed time and breach status.

questions.q: Besides Start, which other condition builders exist on an SLA Definition?
options: Only a single combined On/Off condition
Pause, Stop, and Reset
Priority, Impact, and Urgency
Assignment Group and Assigned To
questions.explain: An SLA Definition has four independent condition builders: Start, Pause, Stop, and Reset.
